text:
We had an excellent experience at Bangkok Chiang Mai Clinic Thaphae when my daughter became ill during our trip. From the moment we arrived, the staff were attentive, kind, and very professional, which gave us peace of mind in a stressful situation.

Dr. Titiporn provided outstanding care - thorough in examination, clear in explanation, and very compassionate with my daughter. The nurses, Thanyarat and Patamavisa, were equally wonderful. They were gentle, patient, and reassuring throughout the visit, making sure my daughter was comfortable and well cared for.

Blood tests and treatment were done quickly and efficiently, with everything clearly explained. The clinic itself is clean, well-organized, and very efficient, with medications provided right on-site.

We are truly grateful for the excellent service and care we received. A big thank you to Dr. Titiporn, Nurse Thanyarat, and Nurse Patamavisa for going above and beyond. Highly recommended for anyone in need of medical care in Chiang Mai.

text:
I called the phone number listed on this clinic’s Google page before coming in to confirm whether I could speak with a doctor about refilling a prescription I receive in the U.S. I was explicitly told they confirmed with the pharmacy this medication was available and that I should come in.

When I arrived, the front desk stated they do not carry this medication and said no one there had spoken to me. I showed them the exact number I called, which is the number attached to their Google business listing, yet I was turned away.

This is a clear communication mishap that resulted in a wasted trip and unnecessary transportation costs. If the number listed is incorrect, the business should fix it.

Posting this so others don’t rely on phone confirmations and end up in the same situation.
